title: Office - F. Inspection at 100 percent but not submitted shows Open
preconds: Logged in as Office. WOL View only, but Settings + Service ON. An inspection can be filled to 100 percent without submitting.
steps:
1. Log in.
2. Fill all inspection items to 100 percent but do NOT click Submit and Generate Report.
3. Observe the inspection status on the line.
expected: Step 2: Not applicable - role cannot fill an inspection. If such a state exists (set by another role), this role only observes it as "Open".
